title: Statistics: Seeing Beyond the Peaks and Valleys
text:
A dataset can be imagined as a mountain range filled with peaks and valleys.
Each value rises and falls across the landscape. From a close view, it appears irregular and scattered, but from a higher perspective, its true structure becomes clear. Statistics helps us step back and reveal the hidden patterns within variation.

title: About
text:
I am a fourth-year Statistics undergraduate in the Department of Statistics, University of Sri Jayewardenepura, with a strong background in Mathematics and Economics. I completed my primary and secondary education at Maliyadeva Balika Vidyalaya. Currently, I am conducting my final-year undergraduate research under the supervision of Prof. Sarath Banneheka.
I am passionate about data analysis, statistical modeling, and programming in R.
My interests include Advanced statistical Inference, Probability and Distribution Theory, Statistical Quality Control, Time Series Analysis, Data Visualization, and real-world problem solving using data.
I enjoy transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support decision-making. By combining knowledge from Statistics, Mathematics, and Economics, I aim to develop data-driven solutions to complex problems and contribute to informed decision-making across various domains.
